name: zira-vision
description: AI vision tools for Zira: evaluate a model on your images, review rare defects and prepare training data. Add it next to the Zira plugin.

interface.longDescription: AI vision tools for Zira: evaluate a model on your images, review rare defects and prepare training data. Add it next to the Zira plugin. It uses the same Zira sign-in and shows a preview before it creates or changes anything. Use it in a Local thread on your computer, not a Cloud task. Image and model analysis use their own Python environment, set up with your consent. Early access.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate a Zira model on a dataset.
Find rare defect examples in recent sessions.
